changes: A simpler layout for Signs, Weighted evidence, and Sources, with one search and consistent filters.
Shared regional ordering and foldable groups across Signs and Weighted evidence, with separate localization and lateralization views.
Ordered classification menus, evidence classes, and anatomy choices, with searchable lists.
Paper citations with recorded authors and DOI links, plus full-width, scrollable results.
Readable statistics tables that show shared context once and preserve differences between results.
Brodmann selections show the area number and name beneath the map. A short page guide explains navigation and scores.
Source-supported region and classification links are available through the same evidence records across the site.
